query:
-- Check what outreachReady means in the enrichmentStats for both searches
SELECT 
  s.id as search_id,
  s.name as search_name,
  COUNT(c.id) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.enrichmentStatus = 'enriched' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as enriched,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.salesApproachData IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_approach,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.briefData IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_brief,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.salesApproachData IS NOT NULL AND c.briefData IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as outreach_ready
FROM searches s
JOIN companies c ON c.searchId = s.id
WHERE s.id IN (900004, 930001)
GROUP BY s.id, s.name;
